text:
elaine: deploy-bot flagged eu-west canary stuck in PostCanary due to chart/image mismatch. seeing readiness failures in a subset of pods. propose two options: pin chart to previous release or hotpatch values. thoughts?

mike: can you paste the diff? is this image-only or values+chart change?

nora: looking now — helm diff shows both image digest and a logging level tweak in values. small but reproducible.

elaine: here's the diff from the canary job:
```diff
- image: registry.redwood/sys-service:sha-aaa111
+ image: registry.redwood/sys-service:sha-bbb222
- logging.level: info
+ logging.level: debug
```

sre-bot: alert -> canary readiness 5% failing across eu-west-1a/1c (probe timeout). no node OOMs.

release-manager: if we hotpatch the logging change we can avoid rollbacks, but release notes must reflect the deviation. pinning the chart is safer for promotion but blocks the new image.

devops: operationally, pin = annotate release and skip promotion; hotpatch = helm upgrade --reuse-values --set logging.level=info --set image=registry.redwood/sys-service:sha-aaa111 
command: `helm upgrade svc-cnr chart/service --namespace prod --reuse-values --set image=...`

mike: hotpatch only if we're confident image digest caused the probe — can we roll forward the image rollback on the registry? maybe image was re-pushed with different digest due to CI rewrite. check registry manifest timestamps.

nora: checked: digest change coincides with a build rebase at 2024-08-07T12:04Z, team lead says non-functional change. Still, some nodes pulled the old digest and others the new (registry replication lag).

elaine: decision proposal: manual pin chart version for eu-west canary -> hold promotion; create hotpatch playbook and run it only if failures increase >2x over next 15m. I'll annotate the release and update the rollforward checklist. :eyes:

release-manager: OK add release note line: "Temporary pin of chart/service to 1.4.2 while investigating registry digest drift; will revert when registry stable." I'll push to release-notes draft.

deploy-bot: promotion paused for release=service-v1.4.3-canary-1746501234 reason=values-drift annotated_by=elaine

devops: I've created a quickplaybook at infra/runbooks/service-hotpatch.md and added the helm command and rollback steps (scale down, wait 30s, verify readiness). linking here: https://git.internal/infra/runbooks/123

mike: :thumbsup: good to have rollback steps. if we need to hotpatch, prefer `--set imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent`? might hide replication issues though.

elaine: noted. we'll avoid changing pullPolicy for the hotpatch. logging revert only. if situation degrades we execute hotpatch and update release notes post-facto.

nora: I'll follow the canary metrics and report every 5m. if readiness >10% failing, flip to hotpatch immediately.

release-manager: tagging the release draft and noting the manual pin action so migration owners see it. also assigned a follow-up to verify registry replication across eu-west.

elaine: thanks all — pin in place and promoter paused. I'll reopen thread if we need hotpatch. :white_check_mark:
